title: An Algebraic Obstruction to Ising Criticality for Finite-BCH Entanglers in Wavelet MERA
abstract: In wavelet MERA for interacting 2D phi^4, any polynomial entangler whose BCH expansion terminates at finite order generates an effective potential of Landau form in the generic case, fixing mean-field universality; degenerate cases depart from mean-field but still miss Ising. Numerically beta stays at 1/2 with no drift toward 1/8 as nonlocality range or variational complexity grows.
key_claims: Finite-BCH polynomial entanglers in wMERA are confined to mean-field universality (generic case)
Reproducing Ising criticality in continuum MERA may need non-polynomial or infinite-BCH entanglers
relevance_note: Abstract only. A continuum-MERA no-go, not a lattice one: our lattice MERAs reach Ising, TCI and Potts conformal data, so there is no contradiction with any anchor. Useful as a boundary on the ansatz class if a cMERA route is revived (non-unitary cMERA was HYP-028's designated fallback in scans #11/#18). Not HYP-033 relevant beyond sharing the word MERA.
